feature: Logical slot failover (failover option / slot sync)
note: This feature spans FOUR separate release-note items in 17, each with slightly different author lists: (1) failover property on the replication protocol -- Hou Zhijie, Shveta Malik; (2) enabling failover on logical slots (pg_create_logical_replication_slot 5th arg) -- Hou Zhijie, Shveta Malik, Ajin Cherian; (3) sync_replication_slots GUC / slot sync worker -- Shveta Malik, Hou Zhijie, Peter Smith; (4) failover option on CREATE/ALTER SUBSCRIPTION -- Shveta Malik, Hou Zhijie, Ajin Cherian. On-screen credit picks the three names most consistently present across items (Hou Zhijie, Shveta Malik, Ajin Cherian); Peter Smith is additionally credited on the sync-worker item only. Flag: if the film wants to cite ONE canonical line, use item (2) below; if it wants the whole feature area, all four should be shown together.
